name: section new
body: fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating; where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42) & cover != null & first_release_date >= 1786060800 & first_release_date <= 1793836800 & (hypes >= 1 | total_rating_count >= 1); sort hypes desc; limit 20;

name: section upcoming
body: fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating; where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42) & cover != null & first_release_date > 1793836800 & first_release_date <= 1825372800; sort hypes desc; limit 20;

name: section acclaimed
body: fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating; where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42) & aggregated_rating >= 85 & aggregated_rating_count >= 5; sort aggregated_rating desc; limit 20;

name: section classics
body: fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating; where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42) & first_release_date >= 473385600 & first_release_date <= 1356998399 & total_rating >= 80 & total_rating_count >= 50; sort total_rating_count desc; limit 20;

name: popular
body: query popularity_primitives "playing" { fields game_id,value,popularity_type; where popularity_type = 3; sort value desc; limit 50; }; query popularity_primitives "want_to_play" { fields game_id,value,popularity_type; where popularity_type = 2; sort value desc; limit 50; };

name: search
body: fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating; search "Zelda: Breath of the Wild"; where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42); limit 20;

name: count
body: where game_type = (0,4,8,9,10) & version_parent = null & themes != (42) & genres = (12,31);

name: memberships
body: fields game,type,collection; where collection = 106 & type = 1; limit 500; offset 0;

name: name contains
body: fields name,artworks.*; exclude checksum; where name ~ *"assassin's creed"* & first_release_date >= -1; sort first_release_date asc; limit 50; offset 100;

name: detail and related
body: query games "detail" { fields name,slug,first_release_date,game_type,version_parent,aggregated_rating,aggregated_rating_count,rating,rating_count,hypes,cover.image_id,artworks.image_id,screenshots.image_id,genres.name,genres.slug,themes.name,themes.slug,platforms.name,platforms.platform_family,age_ratings.organization,age_ratings.rating_category.rating,summary,storyline,url,game_status,version_title,parent_game,involved_companies.company.name,involved_companies.company.slug,involved_companies.developer,involved_companies.publisher,alternative_names.name,videos.video_id,collections.name,collections.slug,franchises.name,franchises.slug,remakes,remasters,dlcs,expansions,standalone_expansions,similar_games; where slug = "hades"; limit 1; }; query screenshots "screens" { fields image_id; where game = 113112; limit 20; }; query involved_companies "devs" { fields company.name; where developer = true; limit 10; };
